raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly resolved Britannica’s 405–406 timeframe as “the end of 405,” despite widely attested sources (e.g., the traditional date of December 31, 406) indicating the Rhine crossing—and thus the invasion—occurred at the end of 406. This misinterpretation led the process toward the wrong year.
